anomalies.description: A white and teal van (Solar Heat & Air Services) is seen swerving sharply left across lane lines and making contact with a silver sedan in the adjacent lane, causing visible impact and vehicle displacement.

A silver sedan in the right lane loses control, veers left across the lane line, and collides with a black sedan directly ahead of it, causing the black sedan to spin and the silver sedan to become airborne and flip over.
A silver sedan loses control in the right lane, veers sharply left, collides with a black sedan, and flips onto its roof, sliding along the highway before coming to rest against the concrete barrier.
A silver sedan loses control on the highway, flips onto its roof, slides along the concrete barrier, and comes to rest heavily damaged on its side.

A second vehicle (light-colored sedan) is seen already crashed and stationary against the barrier further ahead, likely from an earlier incident; it remains visible but no new impact occurs in this interval.
At an urban intersection, a red-and-white bus collides with a red pickup truck while both are turning or crossing; the impact occurs near the crosswalk with other vehicles present.

A dark SUV (left lane) collides with a white sedan (center lane) at an intersection while both are moving forward; the impact generates a large cloud of dust/debris and causes visible vehicle deformation and rotation.

A dark SUV (left) collides with a red sedan entering the intersection from the left, producing a large spray of water/mud and visible vehicle deformation; the red car is pushed sideways across the intersection.

A red car entering from the left crosses the intersection and appears to be struck or involved in secondary contact amid the ongoing crash debris, evidenced by sudden lateral motion and proximity to the primary collision zone.

Immediately after the first impact, the red sedan (now heavily damaged) collides with a white sedan ahead in the same lane, causing further displacement and smoke/vapor emission from the vehicles.; The white sedan involved in the second collision sustains visible damage; its driver-side door opens abruptly (possibly due to impact or occupant egress), and the vehicle remains stationary with ongoing smoke/vapor emission.
